snippet.title: World's First Gujarati Horror Game! | Spooky Tales: Nini's Teddy (Official Trailer)
snippet.description:
Presenting the World's First Gujarati Horror Game! 🪓🩸

You think you're tough enough to handle the paranormal? Wait until the spirits remind you exactly whose house you just broke into. Experience a terrifying blend of psychological dread, intense survival mechanics, and localized Gujarati voice acting that will have you screaming "Alya Mummy! Bhoot!" before you can even run.

In Spooky Tales: Nini's Teddy, you must explore a haunted household, uncover dark satanic rituals, and survive a relentless, horrifying entity known only as "Mom." Some memories should stay buried... but she left her teddy behind. Only you can stop it. Can you?

🎮 WISHLIST & Pre-Register NOW!

Steam (PC): https://store.steampowered.com/app/4906290/Spooky_Tales_Ninis_Teddy/

Google Play (Mobile): https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.BlackBrainStudios.SpookyTales

itch.io (PC/Mac):https://blackbrainstudios.itch.io/spooky-tales



💻 GAME FEATURES
Fully Localized Voice Acting: Deeply immersive, hilarious, and terrifying Gujarati dialogue and reactions.

Dynamic Survival Gameplay: Use your flashlight and unique blue-light investigation tracking mechanics to find clues while managing high-stakes hiding scenarios.

Atmospheric Terror: Stunning 3D environmental horror built in Unity, designed to keep your heart racing from start to finish.
